text:
A beautiful princess loved to play in the cool garden beside a deep forest well. Her most precious treasure was a golden ball that gleamed in the sunlight.

One afternoon, she tossed it too high — and it slipped from her fingers and fell — SPLASH! — into the dark well below.

The princess began to cry. Suddenly a small green frog popped up from the water. "Why do you cry, Princess?" he croaked.

"My golden ball!" she sobbed. The frog said, "I will get it back for you — if you promise to be my friend, let me eat from your plate, and sleep on your pillow!"

"Yes, yes, of course!" the princess agreed quickly. The frog dove deep into the well and came back up with the golden ball gleaming in his tiny mouth.

The princess grabbed it and RAN back to the palace — completely forgetting about her promise!

That evening at dinner, there was a knock at the palace door. The King himself opened it — and there sat a small green frog! "Your daughter promised to be my friend," he said.

The King looked at his daughter. "A princess ALWAYS keeps her promises," he said firmly.

Unhappily, the princess let the frog eat from her golden plate. Then she let him sit beside her at dinner, even though she found it very difficult. The King watched with quiet approval.

"A true princess," he said, "is known by her word."

When the princess finally carried the frog to her room as promised, something magical happened! A shimmer of golden light surrounded him — and suddenly, a handsome prince stood before her!

"A wicked witch turned me into a frog," he explained. "Only true friendship could break the spell!"

The princess and the prince became the very best of friends, and in time they ruled the kingdom together with kindness and wisdom.

🌟 THE END 🌟

💡 Moral: Always keep your promises — they matter more than you think!
